name: Four Horsemen
source:
Four Horsemen is a visual novel / SLG about homelands and the immigrant experience. Play as a group of four contemporary immigrant teenagers squatting in a World War II era machine gun bunker, trying to find a place for themselves in a pre-apocalyptic, present-dystopian country that has no place for them. Will you go native, turning against your own people to bury the past your parents fled to escape? Will you cling to your parents' identity at any cost, at the price of being a permanent stranger in your home country? Or will you strike out on your own, turning against both your homelands to shape a destiny for yourself? Love is all you need...and also improvised firearms.

Four Horsemen is not another hagiographic, pioneer-tradition, self-exotifying immigrant explainer about being slightly different. It is an exploration of human migration in terms of people–neither as mythology nor as political platform, but as a difficult decision made by ordinary human beings caught in impossible circumstances, with everyday consequences that ripple for generations. This isn’t a game about finding yourself…it’s a game about your self finding you.

[From [url=http://nuclearfishin.com/fourhorsemen/story/]official website[/url]]
translation:
四骑士是一部关于家园和移民经历的视觉小说/SLG。扮演一群四名当代移民青少年，蹲在二战时期的机枪掩体中，试图在一个前世界末日、现在的反乌托邦国家中为自己找到一席之地，而这个国家已经没有他们的容身之地了。你会回归本土，与自己的人民为敌，埋葬你父母逃离的过去吗？你会不惜一切代价，以永远成为祖国的陌生人为代价，坚持父母的身份吗？或者你会独自出击，与两个祖国为敌，为自己塑造命运？你所需要的就是爱……还有简易枪械。

《四骑士》并不是另一部传记式的、先锋传统的、自我陶醉的移民解释者，讲述了略有不同的情况。这是从人的角度对人类移民的探索——既不是神话，也不是政治纲领，而是普通人在不可能的情况下做出的艰难决定，其日常后果波及几代人。这不是一个关于寻找自我的游戏……这是一个关于你的自我发现你的游戏。

[来自[url=http://nuclearfishin.com/fourhorsemen/story/]官方网站[/url]]
